interpretation: The gain is broad across municipalities but not stable across every forecast year.
Largest gains are concentrated among smaller municipalities, matching the pre-existing geographic error diagnostic.
Several small municipalities deteriorate materially in individual years, so the blend is not robust enough for production promotion.
Lulea is largely unaffected and modestly improved on average because its core4 weight is close to 0.89.
next_gate: Use a strictly out-of-time rolling-origin calibration/validation design for any population-reliability rule before considering promotion. Do not tune a fixed threshold or C on the same 2019-2024 evaluation results.
